reasoning.description: Your internal thought process and analysis before deciding how to respond

queries.description: Database queries to execute before responding. Use empty array [] when no data is needed.

query_type.description: The type of database query to execute

next_call_instruction.description: Detailed instructions for the next iteration. REQUIRED when queries is not empty.

actions.description: Actions to execute. Must be empty [] when queries is not empty. Must have at least one item when queries is empty and you want to respond.

action.description: Action type: message, send_audio, send_video, send_image, audio, sticker, picture, image, describe, web_search, transcribe, remember, twitter, instagram, resume, help, model, consumption, favorite, gallery

content.description: Message text content. Required for message action.

language.description: Language code. Required for message action.

parameters.description: Action parameters. Structure varies by action type.
